integrity: Exact formulas and a complete analytic proof are included; finite rational tests corroborate but do not establish the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Regular Euclidean simplices of dimension at least three; a common branch contraction factor strictly between zero and one. Tie-breaking by minimum label; transience bound not claimed optimal; basin measure is normalized simplex volume. Publication priority beyond inspected literature and an independent audit are not established.
title: Farthest-vertex simplex contractions have factorially many attracting cycles
